title: fix: Raise ApiError instead of RetryError when GET retries are exhausted

files.patch:
@@ -20,6 +20,10 @@ Check our main [developer changelog](https://developer.paddle.com/?utm_source=dx
 - Added `api_key.read` to `ApiKeyPermission`
 - Added `api_key_rotation.created` and `api_key_rotation.updated` events, including simulation payload support
 
+### Fixed
+
+- `GET` requests that exhaust their retries on a retryable status (429, 5xx) now raise the corresponding `ApiError` (including `retry_after`) instead of a generic `requests.exceptions.RetryError`
+
 ## 1.18.0 - 2026-11-05
 
 ### Added

@@ -242,6 +242,8 @@ def build_request_session(self) -> Session:
         retries = Retry(
             total=self.retry_count,
             backoff_factor=1,
+            # Return the last response once retries run out so the API error (and its Retry-After) is surfaced.
+            raise_on_status=False,
             status_forcelist=[429, 500, 502, 503, 504, 520, 521, 522, 523, 524],
         )
         session.mount("https://", HTTPAdapter(max_retries=retries))

 from json import loads, dumps

 from pytest import mark, raises

 import requests
 
+from paddle_billing import Client
 from paddle_billing.Exceptions.ApiError import ApiError
 from paddle_billing.Exceptions.ApiErrors.AddressApiError import AddressApiError
 
@@ -198,3 +201,48 @@ def test_client_throws_connection_error(self, test_client, mock_requests):
 
         assert isinstance(exception, RequestException)
         assert str(exception) == "Some Connection Error"
+
+    def test_get_with_exhausted_retries_raises_api_error_with_retry_after(self):
+        hits = []
+
+        class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
+            def do_GET(self):
+                hits.append(1)
+                body = dumps(
+                    {
+                        "error": {
+                            "type": "request_error",
+                            "code": "too_many_requests",
+                            "detail": "Too many requests",
+                            "documentation_url": "https://developer.paddle.com/v1/errors/shared/too_many_requests",
+                        },
+                        "meta": {"request_id": "f00bb3ca-399d-4686-889c-50b028f4c912"},
+                    }
+                ).encode()
+                self.send_response(429)
+                self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
+                self.send_header("Retry-After", "1")
+                self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
+                self.end_headers()
+                self.wfile.write(body)
+
+            def log_message(self, *args):
+                pass
+
+        server = HTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), Handler)
+        thread = Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
+        thread.start()
+
+        try:
+            client = Client("key", retry_count=1)
+            # The retry-enabled session is only mounted for https://, so mount it for the local http server too.
+            client.client.mount("http://", client.client.get_adapter("https://"))
+
+            with raises(ApiError) as exception_info:
+                client.get_raw(f"http://127.0.0.1:{server.server_port}/some/url")
+        finally:
+            server.shutdown()
+            server.server_close()
+
+        assert exception_info.value.retry_after == 1
+        assert len(hits) == 2
